items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15, 1 µL with p20 and 50 µL with p300, the final 61 µL is well within the 200 µL well, and all checks passed.
Each plasmid and each SOC dispense uses pick_up and drop_tip with a fresh tip; tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination all passed.
The code adds steps the paper doesn't describe: p20.mix(3,5) on the competent cells, p300.mix(3,30) after the SOC, blow-outs, and a 45 C lid setting. These are invented handling steps.
The block is set to 4 C with the lid open, then 1 µL of each plasmid goes from plasmids[i] to cells[i] (A1–H1) with a fresh tip each.
The lid is closed, then the block holds 4 C for 30 min, 42 C for 30 s and 4 C for 2 min, via set_block_temperature on the thermocycler.
50 µL SOC goes into each of the 8 wells after the heat shock, then the lid is closed and the block holds 37 C for 60 min.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the paper's LV volumes, the 4 C/42 C/37 C thermocycler steps and per-sample tip handling, and all measured checks passed. It fails the all-or-nothing fidelity item because it adds mixing and blow-out steps and a 45 C lid setting that the paper doesn't describe.
